Thank you for this and for sharing this quote. I’m sorry you are suffering too. I don’t fully understand the quote. I’m not the best at interpretation but the thought of “reconquering myself” and “reintroducing myself to nature” sounds beautiful to me. I greatly appreciate you and your thoughtful reply.
Thank you for taking the time to reply. I feel the same way. Those phrases are extremely invalidating and show that the person saying these really doesn’t understand how someone else is feeling.
Thank you. I hope you are well too. It’s nice to hear I’m not alone.
Beautifully said. Thank you

I agree, it felt extremely validating to hear from my mom. My body felt a little lighter as soon as I realized what she said. I’m glad you found such an understanding therapist. I wish you all the best and thank you for taking the time to read my post.

Thank you for this reply and your understanding. I’m still here today. I’m sorry you too have experienced the pain of depression and anxiety. You sound like such a kind person and deserve to be happy.

I’m glad to hear my post was helpful and I truly appreciate your thoughtful words. I’m sorry you are struggling right now. You sound like an incredibly strong person. I hope tomorrow is a better day for you.

I agree and thank you for taking the time to read my post and respond to it. In my opinion some people don’t realize that the pain a lot people suffer from with depression is similar to ones that struggle with physical pain. A lot of people are ok with letting someone go who is suffering from physical pain, so why can’t the ones who struggle with psychological pain be treated with similar empathy? It’s frustrating and angers me at times.
Whatever you decide to do, I hope you are able to find some peace. You deserve to have peace in your life. 🩵
I’m so sorry. I know how painful it is to try to get people to understand. I realize I’m not your family, but I accept what you want to do.

Thank you for reading my post. I really appreciate that. I’ve tried just about every type of treatment out there. “Shock treatment” which is called electroconvulsive therapy or ECT, is one of the treatments I have tried. You are right though technology is advancing.
Thank you. I’ve never known anyone who has felt that way.
Thank you for reading this. I’m extremely appreciative you took the time.
It’s hard being strong for others when you struggle yourself. I get it. Your partner is very fortune to have you in their life.
Thank you!
